[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/Z0ZiZOKwlhT3khek6Q/giphy.gif?cid=790b76110287b9ff7b9fb2bf433b2cb996a0e157d5721ccd&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g[/img]

notes.title: ***READ ME IN FULL*** Regarding the C Key Command Issue
notes.notes:
Regarding the issue described below, reported by so many, we must ask for some more time to completely solve it.

[The Issue]
-The key command at the Title screen becomes displayed as C and the game cannot proceed.
-All key commands in the Settings screen become displayed as C.

[Temporary Solution]
***Precautions***
    Please take the utmost caution when working in the Registry Editor.
   -We do not take responsibility for any damages that may arise from the usage of the Registry Editor.
   -Do not carry out the following procedure if you are not experiencing the issue described above.

Procedure
1. Make sure the latest update is applied.
2. Open the PC's Registry Editor.
3. Delete the registry "Studio HG."
4. Restart the game.

If the above does not solve the issue, backup and delete your save files, located in the folder below:

C:\Users\[your username]\AppData\LocalLow\STUDIO HG\MetallicChild\MC_Save.sav

Note: The above folder is hidden by default, please set hidden files to be shown when navigating to this folder.


If the issue persists after taking all of the above steps,
please contact our Customer Service:
https://www.metallic-child.com/en/support.php

We apologize for the trouble and inconvenience.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/P2IqbNoxAVnJTbCsZW/giphy.gif[/img]

such as maintenance and security.

notes.title: 『METALLIC CHILD』Developmental status Vol.7
notes.notes:
Fear Nothing with a Dignified Stance

With the Gauntlet and Hammer,
evasion was how you could dodge attacks.
With the Sword&Shield, "guarding" with the shield is the way to go!
In fact, it's the only way to go.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1OUgCaaRJCUQYZAXeS/giphy.gif[/img]
Dodge melee and energy attacks by guarding.
But remember, as with evading, guarding consumes your battery.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ae8fYFCVyqCQcJSkLV/giphy.gif[/img]
Unfortunately, even the toughest of shields
are only effective against physical attacks,
so maneuvering is also important.


Practice Makes Perfect

What if you parry an enemy attack
by guarding at exactly the same time as the attack...?
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/wXcMvUtc46sOcDE1Gl/giphy.gif[/img]

Woah! You guarded [b]without consuming your battery[/b],
AND dealt damage to surrounding enemies!!!
This is the so-called "Just-guard."
The timing is quite severe, hence the high-risk,
but if you master it, you could attack limitlessly......
Well, isn't that awesome!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/mZrR8mvAiQOXYTFdOD/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/kF2MSgbEtLx4nmOXIH/giphy.gif[/img]
Further, installing certain Super-cores will upgrade the Just-guard,
giving such effects as blowing away surrounding enemies,
and unleashing electro-skill attacks.


That's it for this week...

Don't spend too much or too less! How to get the most value out of your "Chips"

Check it out!

notes.notes:
So... what exactly is a "Core?"

Along with the many other strengthening factors that there are,
Rona can receive various buffs by obtaining "Super-cores" and "Mini-cores."

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jqN91VN0TLNn9hB656/giphy.gif[/img]
Some contribute to simple boosts in attack power,
while others have effects such as increased battery charge rates,
allowing for more skills to be unleashed!


However, of course, there is also the risk of receiving a debuff.
For this edition, we will introduce several "Bug-cores" that result in interesting debuffs! 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ViCWKricEOTL7ejoRW/giphy.gif[/img]
Rona picks up a Core and... she got pixelated...!
Some of you may find this to be quite nostalgic?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LMJudqhwELdKI0Mj5z/giphy.gif[/img]
Wait, what's up with the screen?
Seems like she picked up a core that significantly drops the resolution of the monitor...
This is not exactly the kind of nostalgia we want...


You'll only be able to find out whether it is a "good" or "bad" Core after eating it.
Anyone else wonder what it tastes like...?
Rona says it tastes like eggs... but, I'm not taking her word for it...

Look forward to getting a taste for yourself!!
